mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_role WHERE code = #{roleCode} FOR KEY SHARE
SELECT id FROM t_role WHERE code = #{roleCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, role.id FROM t_role role WHERE role.code = #{roleCode}

INSERT INTO lf_grant_affected_pair (user_id, domain_id) SELECT #{userId}, granted_domain.domain_id FROM ( SELECT role_domain.domain_id FROM t_role assigned_role JOIN t_role_domain role_domain ON role_domain.role_id = assigned_role.id WHERE assigned_role.code = #{roleCode} UNION SELECT dgd.domain_id FROM t_role assigned_role JOIN t_role_domain_group role_domain_group ON role_domain_group.role_id = assigned_role.id JOIN t_domain_group_domain dgd ON dgd.domain_group_id = role_domain_group.domain_group_id WHERE assigned_role.code = #{roleCode} ) granted_domain ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
